title: Act 1 - Segment 1: The Journey Begins to Boulder Badge
vanilla_divergence_alerts: HM Slaves: 100% eliminated by 9 reusable Key Item tools. Do NOT instruct players to teach field moves to party members.
Friendship: Eliminated. All friendship evolutions use static level thresholds (e.g. Baby Pokémon evolve at Lv. 15).
Trade Evolutions: Evolve naturally at Level 40 OR via Linking Cord (not Level 37).

critical_missables.title: Secret Garden Discovery
critical_missables.consequence: CRITICAL: If Brock is defeated before battling Blue on Route 22, Blue vacates Route 22 and the Secret Garden is permanently lost for the entire save!

critical_missables.title: Pokémon Collector
critical_missables.consequence: UNDERCOVER INFORMANT PATH: Report the illegal trafficker to the Celadon police officer to gain +10 Karma.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Secret Garden Discovery
objectives: Defeat Rival Blue on Route 22 immediately after returning Oak's Parcel.
Walk through the tree gap on the eastern edge of Route 1 directly below the Viridian City ledge.
CRITICAL: If Brock is defeated before battling Blue on Route 22, Blue vacates Route 22 and the Secret Garden is permanently lost for the entire save!

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Secret Garden Rockruff Nest
objectives: Inspect the center Pokémon nest in Secret Garden.
WARNING: Taking the egg reduces your Karma by 5, which hinders the +20 Karma threshold required for Mew on Mt. Moon Summit.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Mushroom Gathering
objectives: Speak to the chef on the 2nd floor of Pewter Hotel.
Collect 3 Tiny Mushrooms from Viridian Forest.
Deliver the mushrooms to the chef for the Balm Mushroom reward.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Lost Medicine
objectives: Speak to the Youngster on the 2nd floor of Pewter Hotel.
Search under the benches across Pewter City to find his dropped Revive.
Return the Revive to the Youngster. (Do NOT sell or toss it, or you will lose 5 Karma!).

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Bug Evolution
objectives: Speak to the Bug Catcher on the 2nd floor of Pewter Hotel.
Show him a fully-evolved Bug Pokémon (Butterfree or Beedrill, evolved at Lv. 10).
Receive the gift Pineco.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: I Choose You!
objectives: Talk to the Pikachu inside the Pewter City Poké Mart.
Find the official League Hat in the city and return it.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Nectar Garden
objectives: Talk to the old man in the Pewter City flower garden.
Deliver pink flowers from Route 2 (Before Forest) for Oran Berry.
Deliver red flowers from Route 3 for Sitrus Berry.
Deliver blue flowers from Route 4 for Lum Berry.
Catch the visiting Oricorio Sensu Style to receive Berry Juice.

active_and_ongoing_quests.title: Pokémon Collector
rewards: Scraggy (Rocket) OR +10 Karma & Diancie Police Path (Officer Jenny report)
objectives: Meet the Pokémon collector on Route 22.
UNDERCOVER INFORMANT PATH: Report the illegal trafficker to the Celadon police officer to gain +10 Karma.

Secret Garden.lead_summary:
This is a secret location that can be accessed only when defeating Blue in Route 22 the first time. It is possible to permanently miss this trigger due to it being an optional rival fight - Blue disappears from the route after the player defeats Brock.
The Secret Garden is accessed by going through the trees on the right side of Route 1, directly below the entrance to Viridian City. This area can be repeatedly returned to once unlocked.

authoring_guidance.splicing_safety: Explicitly state: HEAD species, BODY species, and WHICH ability to select at the DNA Splicer prompt.
authoring_guidance.unfuse_safety: Unfusing at Pokémon Mart costs $300. Check move retention before unfusing.
authoring_guidance.gym_duel_rule: Strict 2v2 party limit! Instruct player to deposit extra party members in the PC before entering gym arena.
authoring_guidance.time_of_day: Provide Day/Night alternative suggestions so players are never blocked by real-time spawn windows.
authoring_guidance.stone_evolutions: Advisory: Do NOT use evolution stones prematurely on stone-evolvers (e.g. Nidorino) before key level-up moves are learned.
authoring_guidance.undercover_informant_rocket: Guide player to join Team Rocket for disguises/missions, BUT report crimes to police officer for +10 Karma and Diancie unlock!
